title: “World War II and the Prospect of ‘Quit India’ in Bengal: Perceptions, Rumours and Revolutionary Parties”
note: Peer-reviewed article in South Asia: Journal of South Asian Studies 44(1), 2021; studies Bengal in 1940–42.
whyItMatters: Analyses wartime perceptions, rumours and revolutionary parties in Bengal in 1940–42, giving the provincial background to Quit India.
